import sys
from collections import deque

class Graph:
    def __init__(self, vNum, src, sink):
        self.vNum = vNum
        self.src = src
        self.sink = sink
        self.res = [[0] * vNum for _ in range(vNum)]
        self.cost = [[0] * vNum for _ in range(vNum)]
        self.d = [0] * vNum
        self.p = [-1] * vNum

    def add_edge(self, from_, to, capacity, cost):
        self.res[from_][to] += capacity
        self.cost[from_][to] = cost
        self.cost[to][from_] = -cost

    def find_cheapest_path(self):
        INF = 10**9
        self.d = [INF] * self.vNum
        self.p = [-1] * self.vNum
        self.d[self.src] = 0

        # Bellman-Ford
        for _ in range(self.vNum - 1):
            updated = False
            for i in range(self.vNum):
                if self.d[i] == INF:
                    continue
                for j in range(self.vNum):
                    if self.res[i][j] > 0 and self.d[i] + self.cost[i][j] < self.d[j]:
                        self.d[j] = self.d[i] + self.cost[i][j]
                        self.p[j] = i
                        updated = True
            if not updated:
                break

        return self.p[self.sink] != -1

    def augment_path(self, from_, to, flow):
        path_cost = 0
        # find min residual capacity along path
        cur = to
        while cur != from_:
            flow = min(flow, self.res[self.p[cur]][cur])
            cur = self.p[cur]

        # update residual graph and compute cost
        cur = to
        while cur != from_:
            self.res[self.p[cur]][cur] -= flow
            self.res[cur][self.p[cur]] += flow
            path_cost += self.cost[self.p[cur]][cur] * flow
            cur = self.p[cur]

        return flow, path_cost

    def get_min_cost_max_flow(self):
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        while self.find_cheapest_path():
            flow, cost = self.augment_path(self.src, self.sink, 10**9)
            total_flow += flow
            total_cost += cost
        return total_flow, total_cost


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    
    n = int(next(it))
    s = next(it)
    string = list(s)
    
    letters = 26
    let_count = [0] * letters
    for ch in string:
        let_count[ord(ch) - ord('a')] += 1
    
    b = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    
    source = 0
    char_offset = 1
    pair_offset = char_offset + letters
    sink_offset = pair_offset + n // 2
    sink = sink_offset
    vnum = sink_offset + 1
    
    g = Graph(vnum, source, sink)
    
    # Source -> Letters -> Pairs
    for i in range(letters):
        g.add_edge(source, char_offset + i, let_count[i], 0)
        for j in range(n // 2):
            c1 = string[j]
            c2 = string[n - j - 1]
            if c1 == chr(ord('a') + i):
                if c1 == c2:
                    g.add_edge(char_offset + i, pair_offset + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]))
                else:
                    g.add_edge(char_offset + i, pair_offset + j, 1, -b[j])
            else:
                if c2 == chr(ord('a') + i):
                    g.add_edge(char_offset + i, pair_offset + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1])
                else:
                    g.add_edge(char_offset + i, pair_offset + j, 1, 0)
    
    # Pairs -> Sink
    for i in range(n // 2):
        g.add_edge(pair_offset + i, sink, 2, 0)
    
    flow, cost = g.get_min_cost_max_flow()
    print(-cost)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
